title: Focus — task creation, completion, and persistence
description: Hand-authored acceptance fixture for an independent todo application. This plan was not generated by a language model. Each criterion names its source requirement in docs/TODO_REQUIREMENTS.md.

criteria.title: A new task appears in the task list
criteria.description: Create one uniquely named task and verify the real list contains exactly one task.
criteria.requirementRef: R1: Adding a non-empty task displays that task in Your tasks.
criteria.expectedBehavior: The submitted task is visible in the task list, not only in the input.
criteria.prerequisites: A fresh browser context with no saved tasks.

steps.description: Enter the unique task name for this run
Verify the exact task text is visible in the task list
Verify exactly one task was created

criteria.title: Completing a task displays its completed state
criteria.description: Continue in the same browser context, complete the created task, and inspect its visible state.
criteria.requirementRef: R2: Marking a task complete visibly identifies that same task as Completed.
criteria.expectedBehavior: The same unique task has the Completed label.
criteria.prerequisites: TODO-01 passed and its page remains open.

steps.description: Verify exactly one task is completed
Verify the original task remains visible in the list
Verify the task row displays Completed

criteria.title: Refreshing preserves the task and its completed state
criteria.description: Reload the same page and verify the original task is still completed without duplicates.
criteria.requirementRef: R3: Refreshing the browser preserves both task text and its completion state.
criteria.expectedBehavior: The original unique task remains visible, completed, and appears only once after reload.
criteria.prerequisites: TODO-02 passed; keep the same browser context and local storage.

steps.description: Reload the same page without changing browser context
Verify exactly one task remains completed after reload
Verify the original task text remains visible after reload
Verify reload did not duplicate or lose the task
